nodes.label: LoopGuard Changelog
nodes.rationale: Packages follow Semantic Versioning while API, protocol, event, workflow, and database contracts carry explicit independent versions.

nodes.label: cloud-app Expo Prototype Deprecation
nodes.rationale: The Expo prototype remains available for one release for migration comparison and is scheduled for removal no earlier than 0.3.0; users move to apps/web and apps/ios.
